preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.nudgeHelp: Ask me to log the odometer if I haven't for this many weeks. 0 turns it off.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Get one heads-up per reminder: a week before date-based service, and when a logged odometer reading gets close to a mileage target.
notifications.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
notifications.unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications. On iPhone, add LifeStash to your Home Screen first.
notifications.notConfigured: Push notifications aren't configured on the server yet.

security.title: Sign-in & security
security.regenerateConfirm: Your old codes will stop working.
security.lowCodes: You're running low on recovery codes. Generate new ones.
security.credentialsHelp: Use these to sign in on devices without passkeys, like your PC.
security.noPassword: No password set yet — you can only sign in with a passkey.
security.newPasswordKeep: New password (leave empty to keep the current one)
security.reauthDescription: For your security, sign in again before changing passkeys or recovery codes.

export.title: Backup & export
export.description: Download everything as JSON, or individual tables as CSV for spreadsheets.

users.peopleDescription: Everyone who can sign in. Only you can let people in.
users.invitesDescription: One-time links, valid for 7 days. There is no public sign-up.
users.inviteNameHelp: Pre-fills their name and labels the invite here.
users.householdHelp: Only you decide this. They can't change it.
users.linkReady: Send this link to them. It works once.
users.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it.
users.linkHelp: Expires {{date}}. It's shown only now; revoke it below if it goes to the wrong person.
users.moveDescription: They'll see and edit everything in your household. Records in their old household stay there.
users.disableDescription: They're signed out everywhere and can't sign in until you enable them again. Nothing is deleted.
